local_checks.invariant: Every file mutation reachable from a GUI burst that can later re-execute must be captured by the burst's change tracking (gui_changes) or neutralized by stray-kill before a snapshot can persist it.
local_checks.result: The desktop template command is ['/usr/local/bin/agentbox-desktop-start'] (config.py:74), whose start script execs startxfce4 as uid 1001 desktop with HOME=/home/desktop (agentbox-desktop-start:13-14,30). /home/desktop is mode 700 owned by desktop (Dockerfile:28-30), so the burst principal (uid 1001, reachable via the run-2 N-1 xfce4-terminal path) can write /home/desktop/.config/autostart/*.desktop. workspace_manifest's find is scoped to {WORKSPACE} (/workspace) only (sandbox.py:499), so _close_gui_burst's diff_manifest (service.py:237-248) never records a write under /home/desktop. snapshot() docker-commits the whole container including /home/desktop (sandbox.py:478). restore() rebuilds from the committed image and re-runs tpl.command (sandbox.py:516-520), re-executing startxfce4 and any ~/.config/autostart entry as uid 1001 outside any burst. The re-executed process launches at container boot, so it is always present in the burst-open baseline and exempt from gui_strays (sandbox.py:216). Net: a GUI-burst write outside /workspace is invisible to gui_changes, survives into snapshots, and re-executes on restore/restart with no monitoring.
